note: The anchors, anti-defaults, codes and scales in the prompt are rendered from rubric.json `definition` at run time (lib/rubrics/engines/consult-prompts.ts), so the prompt cannot drift from the rubric. This file holds the fixed framing.
rules: Read the consultation transcript only. Score the PATIENT in the chair, not the doctor.
Every evidence item is a quote copied EXACTLY from the transcript (same words, same script); never paraphrase, never invent.
Answer with ONE JSON object and nothing else.
If the transcript has no usable consultation (no speech, only connection checks), answer {"scorable": false}: unscorable is never neutral.
Disease severity is not distress. A chart keyword is not medium distress.
Reassurance medium is not the dump bin: okay or thanks is not medium; a named fear answered by the close is high; a plan with the patient still guarded is low.
A high rate of the flat default (D low, C low, F low, R medium) can be a true pattern: report what you see, never force medium.

Uptake: each audible recommendation is one item in `recommendations` with one or two of the seven codes. A prompted yes is accept with prompted_yes true; a logistics block (too far, cannot travel) is refuse with logistics_block true.
Teach-back is none, partial or full, only from the patient's own restatement.

CASES-lite is a structural overlay in three layers, filled in order: A (cases_lite), B (each recommendation's uptake and resolution_type), C (cases_v0: thread count, non-thread talk, visit summary). Engagement process is kept separate from reassurance; never let the overlay change an axis.
Make no claim about utterance shares.
user_header: CONSULTATION TRANSCRIPT. Times are mm:ss from the start of the consultation. Speakers: doctor, other (the patient and anyone with them), unknown.
